preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of Catowice residents is between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of friendship pairs between residents and cats is between 1 and 1,000,000.
Each resident and cat are numbered between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of some resident and some cat is listed at most once.
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate friendship pairs.

preconditions.expression: For every i there exists a pair between i-th resident and i-th cat.
preconditions.description: Each resident is acquainted with their own cat.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases is at most 1,000,000.
preconditions.description: The total number of residents across all test cases is at most 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: The sum of m over all test cases is at most 1,000,000.
preconditions.description: The total number of friendship pairs across all test cases is at most 1,000,000.

postconditions.expression: Output is either 'Yes' or 'No' for each test case.
postconditions.description: Each test case must output 'Yes' or 'No' to indicate whether it's possible to select the jury and contestants.

postconditions.expression: If 'Yes', then output two integers j and p such that j + p = n.
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', then the sum of the number of jury members and the number of contestants must equal the total number of residents.

postconditions.expression: If 'Yes', then output j distinct integers from 1 to n for the jury.
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', then the jury must consist of distinct residents.

postconditions.expression: If 'Yes', then output p distinct integers from 1 to n for the contestants.
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', then the contestants must consist of distinct cats.

postconditions.expression: Jury members must know none of the contestants.
postconditions.description: The residents in the jury must not be acquainted with any of the cats that are contestants.

invariants.expression: Each resident is acquainted with exactly one cat.
invariants.description: Each resident is paired with exactly one cat.

invariants.expression: Each cat is acquainted with exactly one resident.
invariants.description: Each cat is paired with exactly one resident.
